definitions.explanation: A group of warships organized under a single commander for military operations. Used in both historical and modern military contexts, as well as in science fiction and gaming.

examples.japanese: {艦隊|かんたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出港|しゅっこう}→出港：11764_shukkou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{連合|れんごう}→連合：14450_rengou⟧{艦隊|かんたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{海戦|かいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{戦|たたか}った→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
examples.english: The combined fleet fought a major naval battle in the Pacific.

notes:
USAGE:
Originally a military term but widely known through historical education, war films, and popular culture. The word gained widespread modern recognition through the game franchise {艦隊|かんたい}⟦これくしょん→コレクション：07327_korekushon⟧ (KanColle). Also commonly used in science fiction for space fleets.

ETYMOLOGY:
The ⟦{連合|れんごう}→連合：14450_rengou⟧{艦隊|かんたい} (Combined Fleet) was the main fleet of the Imperial Japanese Navy and features prominently in Japanese World War II history.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{連合|れんごう}→連合：14450_rengou⟧{艦隊|かんたい}: combined fleet
- {艦隊|かんたい}⟦{司令官|しれいかん}→司令官：20907_shireikan⟧: fleet commander
- ⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧{艦隊|かんたい}: space fleet
